643-2187-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-2187-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2034-4435-7924.description:
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw two cards due to Alhammarret's Archive.
The Locust God triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4881-5396-6909-6974.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5396-6909-6974.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Carnage to become an Elemental until end of turn
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

6092-7863--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
6092-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1417-2738-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Bridge from Below, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1902-4067-7890.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1902-4067-7890.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

2203-4019-4221--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Vorinclex triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2203-4019-4221--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

3179-4399-4506-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4506-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

215-6478-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-6478-6633.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

423-433-907-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-433-907-1437--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate the Llanowar Scout token by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1824-2530-3168-7349.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-2530-3168-7349.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3168-7349.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Diamond Mare triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

4067-6281-7013-7252.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
4067-6281-7013-7252.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Grave Sifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Grave Sifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Grave Sifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

628-2193-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

4681-5170-6794-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2478-2866-4779-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

647-4251-6911.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-4251-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-2079-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-3750-3967-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3750-3967-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

390-3372-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Hulking Metamorph
390-3372-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Hulking Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Hulking Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Hulking Metamorph's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Hulking Metamorph's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Hulking Metamorph's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

560-2558-3698-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen and Grinding Station trigger
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3705-5231-6701.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying its mana cost.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.
2060-3705-5231-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

2084-5487.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2084-5487.description:
Cast Molten Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

4050-4871-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
4050-4871-6429.description:
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant, adding {B}.
When Razorlash Transmogrant dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

488-874-1482-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of either Delif's Cone or Jeweled Lotus must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-874-1482-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

5803-5894.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
5803-5894.description:
Cast Ready by paying {1}{G}{W}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ready.
Resolve the copy of Ready, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2882-3079-3195-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Dromar's Attendant.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
2882-3079-3195-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Dromar's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

3209-4050-4772-4871.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{G}.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may forego sacrificing the Saproling tokens.

2440-2609-5195.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Soldiers.
2440-2609-5195.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

679-1149-3090.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Lich's Mastery to leave the battlefield.
679-1149-3090.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving an opponent control of Lich's Mastery.
If needed, activate Shadowspear by paying {1}, causing all permanents your opponents control to lose hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
Cause Lich's Mastery to leave the battlefield.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.

1636-4289-4630.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures without summoning sickness.
1636-4289-4630.description:
Activate five creatures you control by tapping them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sisay by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, searching your library for a legendary creature card with mana value less than Sisay's power and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the legendary creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1223-2034-3191.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting Kairi.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kairi, adding {C}{C}.
Kairi dies, triggering its ability granted by Fake Your Own Death and its other ability.
Resolve the first Kairi trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the second Kairi trigger, causing you to mill six cards and return Fake Your Own Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1548-4989.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to block your creatures.
1548-4989.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Duke triggers, giving Port Razer haste and myriad until end of turn.
Declare Port Razer as an attacker.
Port Razer's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of Port Razer attacking each other opponent.
Each Port Razer deals combat damage, triggering themselves, untapping each creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one for each trigger.
At end of combat, the token Port Razers' myriad abilities trigger, exiling them.
Repeat once for each opponent.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the planeswalker.

1429-2034-3388.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost, adding {C}{C}.
Moritte of the Frost dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield as a copy of Lesser Masticore with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Lesser Masticore's ability any number of times to deal infinite damage to any creature(s).
